yt.title: Not a robot
notes: The woman behind Trump in the viral Oval Office clip
Susan Dell, charity co-founder; her husband founded Dell (White House, Oct 7, 2026)
4 tricks keep turning normal clips of her into "proof"; one is AI

lines.text: See that woman behind Trump in the viral Oval Office clip? [1] She is not a robot. [2] She's Susan Dell, a charity co-founder; her husband founded Dell, the laptop company. [3] Four tricks keep turning normal clips of her into 'proof', and one of them is AI.

yt.title: Slow motion
notes: Slow motion makes normal blinks look mechanical
Feb 2026: a slowed clip of her went viral; in the C-SPAN original she moves normally (Lead Stories)

yt.title: Like a WhatsApp forward
notes: One 4.5M-view post (as of Oct 11): a phone filming a TV
Each copy blurs detail, like eyes and expressions

yt.title: Filters guess detail
notes: Enhance filters guess detail; a US court refused AI-enhanced video as evidence (2024)
One viral compilation: filtered, warped close-ups of her face; the frames just before look normal

lines.text: Trick three: AI 'enhance' filters. [1] They guess detail, they don't recover it; even a US court refused AI-enhanced video as evidence. [2] In one viral compilation, close-ups of her face look filtered and warped; the frames just before look normal.

yt.title: Editing, not proof
notes: A red circle, and a voice telling you what to see

lines.text: Trick four: add a story. [1] A red circle, and a voice telling you what to see. [2] That's editing, not proof.

yt.title: One sign per trick
notes: Everyone moves like they're underwater: slowed
Blur, screen glare, another app's logo: a copy
Plastic-looking skin, eyes that change shape: a filter
Mute it, ignore the circle; still weird? Find the full original

lines.text: Next time it lands in your group, check: [1] if everyone moves like they're underwater, it's slowed. [2] Blur, glare or another app's logo means a copy. [3] Plastic-looking skin or eyes that change shape mean a filter. [4] Then mute it and ignore the circle; if it's still weird, find the full original.
